plan: This is a second-price auction where bidding my true value is the dominant strategy. Since the price I pay is determined by the second-highest bid (not my own bid), bidding exactly my value of $22 ensures I win whenever it's profitable (value exceeds the second-highest competing bid) and never overpay. Bidding higher risks paying more than my value if I win against a high second bid; bidding lower risks losing profitable auctions. Therefore, I will bid exactly my true value.
